name: Selftest Reference Onboarding
description: A deliberately small extension practice used as the known-good reference for the eval harness selftest. It covers team onboarding onto an internal platform, from a first guided pilot through to unaided self-service adoption.

citations.name: Team Topologies: Organizing Business and Technology Teams for Fast Flow
citations.description: Defines the platform team as a team type whose purpose is to reduce the cognitive load of stream-aligned teams by offering self-service internal products.

citations.name: CNCF Platforms White Paper
citations.description: Describes platforms as products offering curated, self-service capabilities to internal users, and sets out attributes and maturity signals for platform teams.

citations.name: What I Talk About When I Talk About Platforms
citations.description: Argues that a digital platform is a foundation of self-service APIs and tools that lets delivery teams ship with autonomy, and that adoption must be earned rather than mandated.

alphas.name: Platform Onboarding
alphas.description: The progression of a delivery team from first guided contact with the platform to unaided self-service use of it.

states.name: Piloted
states.description: A first delivery team has onboarded with platform team support.

checklist.name: A pilot team has deployed a workload through the platform
checklist.description: The pilot team has taken a representative workload from source to running state using only platform-provided capabilities.

checklist.name: Onboarding friction points are recorded
checklist.description: The platform team has captured the specific points where the pilot team needed direct help.

checklist.name: A named platform engineer supported the pilot end to end
checklist.description: One platform engineer accompanied the pilot team through the whole onboarding path.

states.name: Standardised
states.description: Onboarding follows a documented, repeatable path that several teams have completed.

checklist.name: The onboarding path is documented end to end
checklist.description: Every step from access request to first deployment is written down and kept current.

checklist.name: Three or more teams have onboarded through the documented path
checklist.description: The path has been exercised by enough teams to show it generalises beyond the pilot.

checklist.name: Time to first deployment is measured per team
checklist.description: The platform team records elapsed time from onboarding start to first successful deployment.

states.name: Self Served
states.description: Teams complete onboarding without platform team involvement.

checklist.name: A team has onboarded with no platform team contact
checklist.description: At least one team reached first deployment using only self-service materials and tooling.

checklist.name: Onboarding requests are served by automation
checklist.description: Access, workspace creation and starter templates are provisioned without manual handling.

checklist.name: Adoption figures are published to platform stakeholders
checklist.description: Onboarding volume and time to first deployment are reported on a regular cadence.

alphas.name: Onboarding Readiness
alphas.description: The state of the prerequisites a delivery team must satisfy before it can be onboarded onto the platform.

states.name: Stated
states.description: The prerequisites for onboarding have been written down.

checklist.name: Prerequisites for onboarding are listed
checklist.description: The platform team has named what a delivery team must have in place before it starts.

checklist.name: An owner is named for each prerequisite
checklist.description: Every prerequisite has a person or team accountable for satisfying it.

checklist.name: The prerequisite list is published where delivery teams can find it
checklist.description: The list is held somewhere delivery teams already look rather than in platform team notes.

states.name: Checkable
states.description: Each prerequisite can be verified without asking the delivery team.

checklist.name: Each prerequisite has an objective check
checklist.description: A prerequisite is satisfied or not by evidence the platform team can observe directly.

checklist.name: Checks run against a candidate team on request
checklist.description: The platform team can run the full readiness check for a named team on demand.

checklist.name: Check results are recorded against the team
checklist.description: The outcome of each readiness check is kept so progress is visible over time.

states.name: Enforced
states.description: Onboarding cannot start until the readiness checks pass.

checklist.name: Readiness checks gate the start of onboarding
checklist.description: The onboarding path refuses to begin for a team whose checks have not passed.

checklist.name: Check failures return a specific remedy to the team
checklist.description: A failed check tells the delivery team what to do next rather than only that it failed.

checklist.name: Exceptions to the gate are recorded with a reason
checklist.description: Where the gate is bypassed, the decision and its justification are written down.

alphas.name: Developer Workspace
alphas.description: A provisioned working environment a delivery team receives through the platform, treated as a named variant of a platform asset.

states.name: Identified
states.description: The need for a workspace of this shape has been recognised.

checklist.name: A team has requested a workspace
checklist.description: A named delivery team has asked for a working environment through the platform.

checklist.name: The workload the workspace must host is described
checklist.description: The request states what will run in the workspace.

states.name: Specified
states.description: The workspace contents and limits have been defined.

checklist.name: Workspace resource limits are set
checklist.description: Compute, memory and storage ceilings for the workspace are stated.

checklist.name: The toolchain included in the workspace is listed
checklist.description: The request records which tools the workspace ships with.

states.name: Provisioned
states.description: The workspace exists and the team can reach it.

checklist.name: The team can authenticate to the workspace
checklist.description: Members of the requesting team can sign in and reach their workspace.

checklist.name: The workspace was created by automation
checklist.description: Creation ran through the platform's provisioning path rather than by hand.

states.name: Integrated
states.description: The workspace is connected to the platform's shared services.

checklist.name: The workspace reaches the source repository
checklist.description: Code can be fetched and pushed from inside the workspace.

checklist.name: The workspace reaches the build service
checklist.description: A build can be triggered from the workspace.

states.name: Operational
states.description: The team works in the workspace day to day.

checklist.name: The team deploys from the workspace
checklist.description: Deployments to a platform environment originate from the workspace.

checklist.name: Watch workspace availability and alert on loss
checklist.description: The platform team is alerted when a workspace becomes unreachable.

states.name: Value Yielding
states.description: The workspace demonstrably shortens the team's delivery cycle.

checklist.name: Lead time is measured for teams using the workspace
checklist.description: The platform team records delivery lead time for workspace users.

checklist.name: The measured lead time is reported to stakeholders
checklist.description: The figure reaches the people funding the platform.

checklist.name: Work held only in the workspace has been moved out
checklist.description: Anything of lasting value has been relocated before withdrawal.

checklist.name: The withdrawal date is agreed with the team
checklist.description: The delivery team knows when the workspace stops being available.

workProducts.name: Onboarding Guide
workProducts.description: The written path a delivery team follows from access request to first successful deployment on the platform.

levelsOfDetail.name: Outline Path
levelsOfDetail.description: Onboarding steps listed in order, each with an owner.

checklist.name: Every onboarding step is listed in order
checklist.description: The guide names each step a team takes, in the sequence they occur.

checklist.name: Each step names who performs it
checklist.description: A reader can tell whether a step is theirs or the platform team's.

levelsOfDetail.name: Worked Path
levelsOfDetail.description: Each step carries exact commands and expected results.

checklist.name: Each step shows the exact command or form to use
checklist.description: A team can follow the step without inferring what to type or submit.

checklist.name: Each step states the result that confirms success
checklist.description: A team can tell whether a step worked before moving to the next.

checklist.name: A worked example runs end to end
checklist.description: The guide contains one complete pass that a reader can follow verbatim.

workProducts.name: Adoption Dashboard
workProducts.description: Reported view of onboarding volume, time to first deployment, and the unaided share.

expectedMetrics.name: timeToFirstDeployment
expectedMetrics.description: Elapsed time from a team starting onboarding to its first successful deployment on the platform.

expectedMetrics.name: unaidedOnboardingShare
expectedMetrics.description: Share of onboardings completed with no platform team involvement.

levelsOfDetail.name: Counted
levelsOfDetail.description: Onboarding volume is reported as a running count per period.

checklist.name: Onboardings per period are counted
checklist.description: The dashboard shows how many teams onboarded in each reporting period.

checklist.name: The count is drawn from platform records rather than reported by hand
checklist.description: Figures come from the platform's own data.

levelsOfDetail.name: Timed And Attributed
levelsOfDetail.description: Volume reported with time to first deployment and aided status.

checklist.name: Time to first deployment is shown per team
checklist.description: Each onboarding carries its elapsed time.

checklist.name: Onboardings needing platform team help are distinguished
checklist.description: The dashboard separates aided from unaided onboardings.

checklist.name: The trend over time is visible
checklist.description: A reader can see whether the figures are improving.

workProducts.name: Workspace Record
workProducts.description: The standing record of a team's workspace, from request through operation to withdrawal.

levelsOfDetail.name: Requested
levelsOfDetail.description: The request states who asked and what the workspace must hold.

checklist.name: Record the requesting team and the workload
checklist.description: The record names who asked for the workspace and what will run in it.

checklist.name: Record the resource ceilings and toolchain
checklist.description: The record states the workspace limits and the tools it ships with.

levelsOfDetail.name: Live
levelsOfDetail.description: The record tracks the running workspace and what it connects to.

checklist.name: Record the provisioning run that created the workspace
checklist.description: The record links to the automated run that produced the workspace.

checklist.name: Record the shared services the workspace reaches
checklist.description: The record lists the repository and build service connections in place.

checklist.name: Record who uses the workspace day to day
checklist.description: The record names the team members working in the workspace.

levelsOfDetail.name: Closed
levelsOfDetail.description: The record carries the workspace's delivery effect and its withdrawal.

checklist.name: Record the delivery lead time of the team using the workspace
checklist.description: The record carries the measured lead time for workspace users.

checklist.name: Record where work held in the workspace was moved
checklist.description: The record shows the destination of anything of lasting value.

checklist.name: Record the agreed withdrawal date
checklist.description: The record states when the workspace stops being available.

personas.name: Platform Engineer
personas.description: Builds and operates the self-service capabilities a delivery team uses during onboarding, and owns the onboarding path itself.

personas.name: Onboarding Delivery Lead
personas.description: Leads the delivery team being onboarded and decides when it is ready to start.

personaGroups.name: Onboarding Team
personaGroups.description: The pairing of platform and delivery people who carry a single team through onboarding.

activities.name: Run A Guided Onboarding Pilot
activities.description: Take one delivery team through the whole onboarding path with a platform engineer alongside.

activities.name: Write Down The Onboarding Prerequisites
activities.description: Name what a team must have in place before onboarding, and publish the list.

activities.name: Make Readiness Checks Observable
activities.description: Turn each written prerequisite into a check the platform team can run unaided.

activities.name: Gate Onboarding On Readiness
activities.description: Wire readiness checks into the start of onboarding so it cannot begin until they pass.

activities.name: Document The Repeatable Path
activities.description: Turn what the pilot learned into a written path with exact commands and results.

activities.name: Automate Workspace Provisioning
activities.description: Replace manual workspace creation with provisioning that runs from the team's own request, so onboarding completes without platform team handling.

activities.name: Connect The Workspace To Shared Services
activities.description: Join a provisioned workspace to the source repository and build service.

activities.name: Shape The Workspace Request
activities.description: Capture what a team needs its workspace to hold, and set its limits and toolchain.

activities.name: Run The Workspace Day To Day
activities.description: Operate provisioned workspaces as a running service, watching availability and reporting the delivery lead time of the teams using them.

activities.name: Withdraw A Workspace
activities.description: Move anything of lasting value out of a workspace and agree its withdrawal date.

patterns.name: Onboarding Adoption Journey
patterns.description: Coordinates onboarding from a single supported pilot, through a documented repeatable path, to unaided self-service adoption.

patternViews.name: Crawl
patternViews.description: One team is taken through onboarding with a platform engineer alongside, and the prerequisites are written down for the first time.

patternViews.name: Walk
patternViews.description: The path is documented and repeated across several teams, readiness becomes checkable, and workspaces are provisioned and connected.

patternViews.name: Run
patternViews.description: Teams onboard unaided, readiness gates the path automatically, and workspaces run as a measured service.

outcomes.name: Shorter Time To First Deployment
outcomes.description: A delivery team reaches its first successful deployment in materially less elapsed time.
outcomes.measureDescription: Measured by the elapsed time from a team starting onboarding to its first successful deployment, compared between teams onboarded before and after the path was documented, and tracked as a trend across onboarding cohorts.

outcomes.name: Onboarding Without Platform Team Effort
outcomes.description: Delivery teams complete onboarding using self-service materials and automated provisioning, releasing platform engineers from accompanying each one.
outcomes.measureDescription: Measured by the share of onboardings completed with no platform team involvement, and by the count of platform engineer hours spent accompanying onboarding per reporting period.

narratives.name: Earning Platform Adoption Rather Than Mandating It
narratives.description: Frames onboarding as the point where a platform earns its adoption, because a delivery team that cannot get started unaided will route around the platform.

Team Topologies: Organizing Business and Technology Teams for Fast Flow

narrativeContexts.narrativeElementName: Act I: The Hero and the Problem
narrativeContexts.context: A delivery team wants to ship, and is handed a platform it has never used. Where getting started needs a conversation with the platform team, the team's first experience of the platform is a queue.

narrativeContexts.narrativeElementName: Act II: The Guide and the Plan
narrativeContexts.context: The platform team treats onboarding as a product surface rather than a support task, writing the path down, making readiness checkable, and provisioning workspaces from the team's own request.

narrativeContexts.narrativeElementName: Act III: Call to Action and Success
narrativeContexts.context: Teams reach their first deployment without platform team contact, and the platform team's effort shifts from accompanying onboardings to widening what the platform offers.
